title: One fetch, then thousands of hits
predict: A thousand people open the same photo in one minute. How many requests reach the origin?
caption: The first request misses and the CDN fetches the same path from the origin; every later request is a hit. The origin hears from the CDN again only when the cached copy expires.

title: The bytes leave your servers' path
predict: Your upload service handles 5 MB photos. How many times do those bytes cross a network your servers sit on, before and after pre-signed URLs?
caption: Through the API server, every photo crosses its network card twice and the card fills. With a pre-signed URL the app asks only for permission, then sends the photo straight to S3.

title: A forwarded URL, before and after it expires
predict: A follower forwards a photo URL with a five-minute expiry. The friend opens it after two minutes, and again after ten. What happens each time?
caption: The CDN checks the URL's signature and expiry, not the person: a forwarded URL works until it expires, and changing the expiry breaks the signature.

title: The same posts, re-keyed by hashtag
predict: Post 31 carries three hashtags. How many messages does it become, and on how many counting servers can #sunset land?
caption: Keyed by user, #sunset is spread over three servers that write one at a time. An extractor re-publishes one event per hashtag on a topic keyed by hashtag, so one server batches it: count += 3.
